supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: Moderate 2D lateral extension where the ridge width significantly exceeds the outer orbital margins.

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: Low contrast; the muzzle exhibits a slightly higher intensity (greyish) relative to the near-black periocular and cheek regions.

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: Thick lower lip with a visible structural droop and exposure of lighter mucosal tissue.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small, high-intensity (white/light) circular spot or lesion located on the left lateral side of the lower muzzle near the corner of the mouth.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct vertical linear thinning or parting of the cranial hair originating at the center of the hairline and extending toward the crown.
